name: kayzen-mcp
description: Kayzen (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a docu

platform_mcp_kayzen_api_basic.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KAYZEN_API_BASIC
platform_mcp_kayzen_api_basic.description: base64(<API_Key>:<API_Secret_Key>) — the Kayzen API key and secret (Kayzen UI > Account > API Key; 'Obtaining your Kayzen API key') joined by a colon and Base64-encoded, e.g. `printf '%s' 'KEY:SECRET' | base64`. Sent as `Authorization: Basic …` on POST /v1/authentication/token only.

platform_mcp_kayzen_username.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KAYZEN_USERNAME
platform_mcp_kayzen_username.description: Kayzen login email of the user the API key belongs to (token request body `username`).

platform_mcp_kayzen_password.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KAYZEN_PASSWORD
platform_mcp_kayzen_password.description: Kayzen account password for that login (token request body `password`); the runtime exchanges it for a 30-minute bearer token and re-logs in on expiry or 401.

platform_mcp_kayzen_advertiser_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KAYZEN_ADVERTISER_ID
platform_mcp_kayzen_advertiser_id.description: Kayzen advertiser id used by `me` (GET /v1/balance?advertiser_id=…). Leave empty to use the API key's default advertiser.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v1/balance → {advertiser: {balance, warning}}; there is no user endpoint, so the balance call verifies the token (and the optional configured advertiser).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /v1/campaigns?advertiser_id=…&page=…&per_page=… (data[] + meta.total_entries). `account_id` is the Kayzen advertiser id (an enterprise admin switches advertisers with it). status is running / paused / …; `budget` is day_budget in USD (total_budget in raw). No status filter is documented, so `status` is not sent.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: POST /v1/report_data {advertiser_id, start_date, end_date, metrics [impressions, clicks, advertiser_spend, ctr], group_by [day, campaign_id, campaign_name], filters {campaign_id: [id]} when campaign_id is given, per_page 1000, time_zone UTC} — synchronous 'Report Data' (no reusable report id). spend is advertiser_spend in USD.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PATCH /v1/campaigns/{id} {data: {campaign: {day_budget}}} — day_budget is an integer number of US dollars (whole dollars only; a fractional amount is rejected before sending). This changes spend. A 422 `budget_overspend_risks` answer is returned as an error; the overspend warning is not bypassed. `currency` is ignored. Kayzen answers 200 with an empty object, so the result carries only status.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PUT /v1/campaigns/{id}/status {status: paused|running} (pause → paused, resume → running). Resuming restarts spend; a 422 `budget_overspend_risks` answer is returned as an error rather than bypassed.
